title: Bag of Bricks - Dark Grey 31
descriptionHtml:
Dark Grey — colour 31

A versatile charcoal that softens the jump between black and mid-grey. Essential for stonework, storm clouds and the shadow detail that makes monochrome portraits work.

Works well with: Black 01, Grey 39, Stone Grey 36

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Dark Grey bricks (colour 31) for Memobrick mosaics. A versatile charcoal for shadows, stonework and monochrome portrait detail.
